Sandbox_PhunTaxi_UseSpawnRoom_tooltip: If yes, a new character wakes up in the Taxi Garage, a room off the map, and leaves by one free taxi ride to any place their player knows. If no, or when the garage is full, they are put straight at the last place their player chose, or a start point they know
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_TaxiFastTravel_tooltip: If yes, a player can call a taxi from any pay phone they know to any other they know, for a fare. The free ride out of the Taxi Garage does not need this and is never charged
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneChance_tooltip: Percent chance a pay phone the map puts down becomes a live one: a spawn point and a taxi stop. Each phone's roll is fixed for the world, so a change reaches every phone nobody has reached yet. The extra spots PhunTaxi ships for empty parts of the map are not rolled on this. At 0, no map phone goes live
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneDistance_tooltip: No pay phone goes live within this many squares of another live one, which decides which map phones and extra spots are used. Phones already standing stay when this changes. Set to 0 for no spacing
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneDiscoverRadius_too: How close, in squares, you have to get to a live pay phone to remember it, and it rings once to say so. Set to 0 and you have to pick the phone up
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_DiscoveryRadius_tooltip: How close, in squares, you have to get to a spawn point that is a place rather than a pay phone before you remember it. Checked once a game minute, so running past may not count. There is nothing at a place to pick up, so this cannot be 0
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_ShowUndiscovered_toolti: If yes, places you have not found are listed greyed out, so the list is somewhere to head for. If no, they are not sent to your client at all. Pay phones are never listed until found
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneRing_tooltip: If yes, a live pay phone you have not found yet rings when you come near it, once per phone each time you play. Picking it up stops it. Each player sets the volume for themselves in Options, Mods
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneRingRange_tooltip: How close, in squares, you have to be for an undiscovered pay phone to ring for you. The ring carries about 30 squares, so a phone rung from further away may not be heard
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneRingSeconds_toolti: How long, in real seconds, an undiscovered pay phone rings before it gives up
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_TaxiCentsPerSquare_tool: Cents of PhunMart change per square travelled, in a straight line. Needs PhunMart unless this and the minimum fare are both 0
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_TaxiMinimumFare_tooltip: The least any fast travel ride costs, in cents. 100 is $1.00
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_TaxiZombieRadius_toolti: A taxi will not come to a pay phone while a zombie is within this many squares of you. Set to 0 to turn this off
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_AllowBuiltPoints_toolti: If yes, a player may craft a Pay Phone Kit and put up a pay phone of their own, for anybody to find and use
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_BuiltPointLimit_tooltip: How many pay phones one player may have standing at once. Set to 0 for no limit
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_BuiltPhoneDistance_tool: A player cannot put up a pay phone within this many squares of any other live one. Set to 0 for no spacing
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_Debug_tooltip: Verbose logging of point registration, discovery and spawning to the console
